'''Gama Bankor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Bankor traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] with a number of [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] and purchased the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Sunchoo]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Crovan Dane]]. However, while Bankor and his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were loading the Wookiee onto their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Kashyyyk Royal City/Legends|Kashyyyk Royal City]], they were spotted by the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Jaylen Kos]] and a [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|Jedi Padawan]]. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] approached Bankor and tricked him into releasing Sunchoo.
